common:generalComment.#text: Reference elementary flow of the International Reference Life Cycle Data System (ILCD).

Brass is an alloy of copper (Cu) and zinc (Zn), in proportions which can be varied to achieve different colours and mechanical, electrical, and chemical properties. It has excellent resistance to seawater corrosion and is easy to machine and form. It also has a biocidal effect which makes it excellent for antibacterial applications. The color of the material is typically golden-yellow, although it may exhibit a reddish color when the alloy contains elevated copper content, commonly referred to as 'red brass.'
黄铜是铜（Cu）和锌（Zn）的合金，可通过改变比例获得不同的颜色以及机械、电气和化学特性。它具有出色的耐海水腐蚀性，易于加工成型。此外，它还具有杀菌效果，是抗菌应用的理想材料。这种材料的颜色通常为金黄色，但当合金中的铜含量较高时，可能会呈现红色，即通常所说的 "红黄铜"。

common:generalComment.#text: Copper solder is a medium and high-temperature welding material based on copper, often with the addition of alloying elements such as zinc, silver, and nickel. It is used for high-strength, high-temperature resistant connections of metal parts and to form dense joints. The core component is copper, and the mainstream alloy systems include copper-zinc series (brass solder), copper-silver series, copper-nickel series, etc. They are suitable for connecting materials such as steel, copper alloys, and stainless steel, and are widely used in mechanical manufacturing, pipeline engineering, high-temperature equipment, and photovoltaic brackets/cable joints, among other scenarios.
铜焊料是以铜为基，常添加锌、银、镍等合金元素制成的中高温焊接材料，用于金属部件的高强度、耐高温连接并形成致密接头。核心成分为铜，合金体系主流包括铜锌系（黄铜焊料）、铜银系、铜镍系等，适配钢铁、铜合金、不锈钢等材质连接，广泛应用于机械制造、管道工程、高温设备及光伏支架 / 电缆接头等场景。

common:generalComment.#text: Solder is a welding material mainly composed of tin, used for low-temperature connection of metal parts and formation of conductive/thermal conductive joints. The core component is tin, which is often alloyed with lead, silver, copper, etc. It is widely used in electronic components, photovoltaic module electrodes, electrical joints and other scenarios to ensure connection reliability.
锡焊料是以锡为主要成分的焊接材料，用于金属部件的低温连接并形成导电 / 导热接头。核心成分为锡，常与铅、银、铜等制成合金，广泛应用于电子元件、光伏组件电极、电气接头等场景，保障连接可靠性。

common:generalComment.#text: This product flow pertains to a capacitor and includes the use of auxiliaries and energy during its lifecycle. It encompasses the level of processing the capacitor has undergone, compliance with industry standards, its quality attributes and how it is used. The production route taken to manufacture the capacitor and the name of any starting materials (educts) are also detailed. It is further clarified whether the capacitor represents a product blend as part of a production or consumption mix. The description includes the location where the capacitor is available, signifying if it is provided to the consumer or if it is accessible at the manufacturing plant.
该产品流程涉及到电容器以及在其生命周期中使用的辅助材料和能源。它包括电容器经历的加工水平，行业标准的符合性，其质量属性以及使用情况。还详细说明了制造电容器的生产路线和任何起始材料（原料）的名称。它进一步明确了电容器是否代表生产或消费混合物中的产品混合物。描述包括电容器的可用位置，表明它是提供给消费者的，还是在制造厂可获得。
